questionStem: Rank these four factors from the most direct to the least direct cause of more jobs outside agriculture.

cards.text: Industrialization and modernization create more jobs in industry and services.
International integration and foreign investment bring more factories and businesses.
Urbanization draws workers from rural areas to cities and industrial zones.
Mechanization reduces the workers needed for each harvest.

taskBody.basis: Use the factors in the paragraph on p. 8.

challengeCandidates.label: TN1
challengeCandidates.message: Does the factor you put first create jobs outside agriculture, or does it free up workers from farming?

challengeCandidates.label: TN2
challengeCandidates.message: Does the factor you put first make new jobs, or move people to where jobs are?

challengeCandidates.label: TN3
challengeCandidates.whenShownForTeacher: When a job-creating factor is ranked first
challengeCandidates.message: Which words in the paragraph show how direct each factor is?

challengeCandidates.label: Fallback
challengeCandidates.whenShownForTeacher: When none of the above applies
challengeCandidates.message: Read your order once more. Could you explain why each card sits above the next one?

feedback.text: The paragraph says industrialization and investment bring jobs and businesses directly; urbanization moves workers, and mechanization frees them from farming.
